messages:
rebecca_cs: Heads-up 10 days till Brightwave East renewal. Procurement replied: they want PO + tax-exempt stamping. CFO will sign. tagging @anya_legal @pat_fin @drew_onboard
omar_ae: Got the PO preference. They attached initial PO template and asked for our vendor code + remit address. Email from procurement@brightwave-east.com
pat_fin: We have two invoice entities. For this region use: Brightwave Platform Ltd (UK) for billing. I'll request vendor code. Net30 requested.
anya_legal: If they're tax-exempt, we need their certificate on file before invoicing. Also KMS addendum if they insist on key escrow language (this is a Dedicated customer?). Confirm deployment type.
drew_onboard: They're on Dedicated. KMS + SSO provisioning will need a short security questionnaire answered. That can be parallel but provisioning waits for signed statement of authorized signer. Estimate +2 business days if PO path used.
rebecca_cs: Action items: Omar get PO # and contact, Pat create vendor code ticket and confirm remit addr, Anya prepare a one-paragraph KMS addendum + a signer matrix template, Drew note onboarding delta. I'll update renewal tracker. :spiral_calendar:
omar_ae: Replied to procurement asking for filled PO and tax certificate. Also asked whether they need invoice to legal or procurement email.
renewal-bot: Reminder  renewal window: 10 days remaining for account brightwave-east (acct 67890).
pat_fin: Vendor code requested: FIN-4980. Remit: Redwood Inference Ltd, 123 Canvas St, London, UK. Logging Net30 terms.
anya_legal: Drafted KMS addendum: short scope + clause "signature does not confirm billing entity until PO entity matches invoice metadata." I'll attach signer matrix fields: Name / Title / Signing Authority Doc ID.
rebecca_cs: Can we pre-populate DocuSign but mark entity field as "Pending PO verification" so signing isn't blocked? Want to avoid back-and-forth.
anya_legal: Ok to pre-populate with that language but add explicit fallback: "If PO indicates different billing entity, parties will execute an administrative amendment." That avoids accidental acceptance.
drew_onboard: Note: if CFO signs under a parent entity different from the one we provision SSO to, we'll need to reissue provisioning invites. Recommend hold SSO invite until PO verified.
omar_ae: Procurement sent PO: PO# BW-2026-331. Attached tax-exempt cert (pdf). Forwarding to legal & finance.
pat_fin: Tax cert looks valid. Vendor code assigned VC-BW-331. I'll update billing entity and prepare invoice template.
omar_ae: Sending DocuSign envelope with PO# in subject and the KMS addendum attached. Envelope id: 0xB22c (https://docusign.internal/0xB22c)
rebecca_cs: Thanks. I'll set a reminder for sign-by in 72 hrs and escalate to AE if not returned. Marking potential +2 day onboarding slip in tracker. :warning:
renewal-bot: Activity-log: PO attached, vendor code assigned, envelope created, tax cert recorded.
